fields.date_basis: Microsoft Research publication page identifies CHI 2025, April 2025. Month precision retained: first-of-month page metadata is not evidence of an exact publication day; the author PDF's January creation date is not publication date.
fields.container_title: Proceedings of the 2025 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
fields.summary: Survey of 319 weekly GenAI users with 936 retained work examples associates greater task-specific AI confidence with less reported critical thinking and self-confidence with more. Describes verification, integration and stewardship as changing cognitive work.
fields.limitations: Self-report, selected examples and observational associations; not an objective skill test, randomized AI intervention or longitudinal measure of decline. Participants may conflate reduced effort with less critical thinking. English-speaking regular-user sample limits generalization; self-confidence need not equal expertise. Most authors are affiliated with Microsoft Research.
